reason: B is the better proposal because W substitution is compositionally plausible in a refractory Hf–Zr–Ti–Ta alloy, is supported by related Ti–Zr–Mo–W high-rate results, and can be tested in a matched strain-rate series. A largely transfers an L1₂-aging treatment from an Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni FCC alloy to a predominantly refractory BCC chemistry lacking known L1₂-forming constituents, making its proposed phase and mechanism physically unsupported.
